findings.title: Three Palestinians killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza City
findings.location: Near Martyrs Square, Al-Shati refugee camp, west of Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Three Palestinians reportedly killed and several injured; identities, individual civilian status, exact injury count and medical verification not established.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: targeted a group of Palestinians near Martyrs Square in the camp, killing three people and injuring several others.
findings.source_type: Palestinian official news agency report attributed to local sources
findings.summary: WAFA reported on November 5 at 18:51 Gaza/West Bank local time that Israeli warplanes struck a group of people at Al-Shati refugee camp on Thursday evening, killing three and injuring several. No independently corroborating primary source located in this bounded watch; no individual civilian identities verified.

bounded_discovery_context.direct_publisher_check: WAFA English homepage and article /Pages/Details/176683; report timestamp 18:51 local, approximately 08:51 PST, after previous heartbeat end 08:44:41 PST.
bounded_discovery_context.uniqueness: Al-Shati/Martyrs Square Gaza City airstrike is separate by location and reported publication time from previously logged Al-Mawasi, Al-Bureij, Al-Zawayda, Deir al-Balah and Khan Younis events.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: WAFA relies on unnamed local sources; no casualty identities, corroborating hospital report, precise strike time or independent confirmation of all victims' civilian status.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; production collector and publisher remain authoritative.
